question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Have a long face
solution:
The correct answer is **"Look unhappy or disappointed"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Long faces** make people appear **unpleasant** or serious.

 
 
• **Example: **Mohini came to me with a very **long face .**
 
 
 
• The meaning of **"Look unhappy or disappointed"** is someone who is looking sad or unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** The boy looks **unhappy or ****disappointed**.
 
 
 
• Both of the phrases are similar.
 
• Therefore, the **option 1)** is the correct solution.
